quiz.title: Data Engineering Basics
quiz.description: The role of a data engineer, the ETL pipeline, Unix/Linux and the Bash terminal, Python with Pandas, and a hands-on Jupyter notebook project.

questions.question_text: What is the primary responsibility of a data engineer?
questions.option_a: Designing and building the systems that collect, store, and move data for others to analyze
questions.option_b: Only creating dashboards and visualizations for executives
questions.option_d: Writing front-end code for a website
questions.correct_answer: Designing and building the systems that collect, store, and move data for others to analyze

questions.question_text: Which of these is a typical deliverable a data engineer produces for data scientists and analysts?
questions.option_a: Clean, reliable, well-structured datasets and pipelines
questions.correct_answer: Clean, reliable, well-structured datasets and pipelines

questions.question_text: In an ETL pipeline, what happens during the 'Transform' step?
questions.option_a: Raw data is cleaned, reshaped, validated, or enriched before loading
questions.option_b: Data is pulled from the source system for the first time
questions.option_c: The final report is emailed to stakeholders
questions.correct_answer: Raw data is cleaned, reshaped, validated, or enriched before loading

questions.question_text: Where does data typically end up after the 'Load' step of an ETL pipeline?
questions.option_a: A target destination such as a data warehouse or database
questions.option_b: The source system it originally came from
questions.correct_answer: A target destination such as a data warehouse or database

questions.question_text: Which command lists the files and directories in the current location on a Unix/Linux terminal?
Which Bash command is used to change the current working directory?
What does the Bash command 'pwd' do?
questions.option_a: Prints the path of the current working directory
questions.correct_answer: Prints the path of the current working directory

questions.question_text: Which Python library is most commonly used for tabular data manipulation and analysis in a data pipeline?
In Pandas, which function is typically used to read a CSV file into a DataFrame?
What is a Jupyter notebook primarily used for in a hands-on data engineering exercise?
questions.option_a: Writing and running code interactively alongside notes, and viewing output inline
questions.correct_answer: Writing and running code interactively alongside notes, and viewing output inline

questions.question_text: In the hands-on ETL project, what is the first step described for getting your own copy of the starter repository?
questions.option_c: Email the instructor for the code
questions.option_d: Download a ZIP from a random website

questions.question_text: After forking the repo and implementing a simple ETL pipeline in Python, what is the final step of the hands-on project?
questions.option_d: Merge directly into an unrelated project
